title: Concept: Maven dependency resolved from the local system path
description: pom.xml declares a dependency with `system` scope, which reads a jar straight from the build machine, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The artifact comes from a path outside repository management, so no checksum, no provenance and no repository policy applies to it.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
risk: The artifact comes from a path outside repository management, so no checksum, no provenance and no repository policy applies to it.
